title: Senior Data Scientist → Associate Director, Technical Lead for Protein Discovery

variants.compbio: Led the supervised-learning strategy for protein optimization: protein language model embeddings with supervised fitness heads, plus active learning and Bayesian optimization to select each design-build-test round's variant library. Nominated hundreds of candidate variants per round and drove multi-objective optimization, surfacing variants with up to a 1.5X increase in activity.
variants.tech: Led an active-learning and Bayesian-optimization program that optimizes candidate designs under a fixed experimental budget: embeddings from large pretrained sequence models feed supervised performance predictors, and adaptive selection targets the highest-value candidates each round. Delivered up to a 1.5X performance gain.

variants.compbio: Built the training dataset for and trained an XGBoost classifier on Evo2 genomic language model embeddings, resolving mobile-genetic-element vs. host by (meta)genomic contig position at single-nucleotide resolution with >90% accuracy, more than doubling (>2X) the MGE training examples available for downstream generative applications.
variants.tech: Built the training data for and trained a gradient-boosted (XGBoost) classifier on embeddings from a large foundation model, reaching >90% accuracy at single-record resolution and more than doubling annotation rate.

variants.compbio: Led development of ElevateBio's protein catalog for therapeutic discovery, delivering active gene-editing effectors across three editing modalities and contributing 300k+ distinct training examples for generative-model fine-tuning; these became key pillars of the company's technology portfolio.
variants.tech: Led development of a searchable catalog (database, search, and API) that became core infrastructure behind the company's discovery programs.

variants.compbio: Built a self-improving agentic system (Anthropic SDK) that ingests and reformats experimental data submissions across three partnered program campaigns, validating output against a schema and feeding successes into a few-shot example bank.
variants.tech: Designed and built a self-improving agentic system on the Anthropic SDK that converts unstructured submissions into schema-validated structured records, with an automated few-shot retrieval loop that learns from its own successful outputs; deployed across three concurrent program pipelines.

eb-benchmarking.text: Developed the company's ML benchmarking and active-learning software.

title: Data Scientist → Data Science Group Leader

variants.compbio: Designed and led AgBiome's AWS genomics data platform: an event-driven system of dozens of pipelines (from k-mer sketching to biosynthetic gene cluster annotation) processing 20,000+ isolated and sequenced microorganisms annually into a queryable database that informed R&D.
variants.tech: Designed and led an event-driven data platform: ingestion pipelines, developer tooling, and a queryable warehouse serving R&D, running dozens of pipelines over 20,000+ new datasets per year.

variants.compbio: Developed AgBiome's internal genome comparison API: a REST service on AWS Lambda and API Gateway for rapid MinHash-based genome search, pairwise comparison, and clustering by similarity.
variants.tech: Built an internal similarity-search REST API (AWS Lambda and API Gateway) using MinHash sketching for fast approximate matching, pairwise comparison, and similarity clustering over large record sets.

variants.compbio: First author on AgBiome's first peer-reviewed publication, an Editor's Pick in Phytobiomes Journal: multivariate and compositional statistical analysis of 16S/metagenomic surveys resolving sweetpotato microbiome community assembly.
variants.tech: Published first-author, peer-reviewed statistical analysis (multivariate and compositional methods) of large observational survey data; an Editor's Pick in its journal.

variants.compbio: Developed cloud infrastructure and developer tooling for real-time analytics and monitoring dashboards.
variants.tech: Built cloud infrastructure and developer tooling for real-time analytics and monitoring dashboards.

ab-blog.text: Founded, built, and deployed an internal data science blog (static site on AWS S3) and contributed regularly, communicating data narratives and results across the company.

title: Lead Faculty and Course Developer for Data Science
organization: UNC Gillings SPH and UNC School of Data and Information Sciences

teach-courses.text: Develop and teach three courses in the Gillings School of Public Health and the School of Data and Information Sciences:
children: Data Science Basics (BIOS-512). grew from 11 students to 50+ with a full waitlist
AI/ML and statistical methods for studying biology (DATA-791)

variants.compbio: Designed and applied a microbiome analysis pipeline for DNA-SIP-based microbial ecology studies of agricultural soils and biological soil crusts.
variants.tech: Postdoctoral researcher: built reproducible data-analysis pipelines and published multiple first-author, peer-reviewed studies.

variants.compbio: Taught data analysis best practices and molecular biology laboratory techniques in microbiome science, and administered the course's Linux servers.
variants.tech: Taught data-analysis best practices and administered the course's Linux servers.
